name: Yum! Brands
description: Yum! Brands franchises and licenses KFC, Taco Bell, Pizza Hut and Habit Burger & Grill: 63,285 restaurants in 155 countries, 97 percent operated by independent franchisees. Yum earns a percentage royalty on franchisee sales, rent on properties, and advertising contributions, and runs a small number of company-owned restaurants (mainly Habit and some Taco Bell, KFC and Pizza Hut). KFC and Taco Bell produce about 89 percent of division operating profit. The Pizza Hut brand is under a strategic review expected to finish in 2026. Mainland China is split off as Yum China, which pays Yum a 3 percent sales-based licence fee.

sub.name: Restaurants, food delivery and foodservice supply

gics.note: Conventional GICS sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-10-01); that list does not show industry group or industry.

hq.note: EDGAR business address; Wikipedia S&P 500 list

employees.note: About 49,000 employees, about 28,000 in the US (FY2025 10-K); franchisee staff not included

businessLines.name: KFC Division
businessLines.how: Franchisees pay a percentage of their sales as royalty, plus rent and advertising contributions; Yum also collects the 3 percent licence fee from Yum China on its mainland China KFC system.
businessLines.description: 33,897 units in 149 countries (90 percent outside the US, 99 percent franchised).

operatingProfit.note: Division operating profit before corporate G&A; share is of the four divisions' $2,959M total; vs $1,363M FY2024

businessLines.name: Taco Bell Division
businessLines.how: Royalties and advertising contributions from mostly US franchisees plus sales at company-owned restaurants (company restaurant expenses $971M).
businessLines.description: 9,030 units in 38 countries (86 percent US, 93 percent franchised).

businessLines.name: Pizza Hut Division
businessLines.how: Royalties, rent and advertising fees from franchisees of delivery and dine-in pizza units.
businessLines.description: 19,974 units in 108 countries (68 percent outside the US, 99 percent franchised); strategic options review under way.

businessLines.name: Habit Burger & Grill Division
businessLines.how: Mostly company-owned restaurants: sells food directly to guests (company restaurant expenses $509M against $570M revenue), so it carries restaurant costs the franchised brands do not.
businessLines.description: 384 units (2 countries), 22 percent franchised; fast-casual chargrilled burgers.

brands.name: Yum China (affiliate, not a brand)
brands.note: Largest master franchisee; pays Yum a 3 percent sales-based licence fee on China KFC, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut sales

whatsNext.text: Strategic options review of the Pizza Hut brand (begun 2025) is intended to complete in 2026; no assurance of any transaction
